# The one place for the operator details on the legal pages.
#
# legal/build.mjs puts these values into the markdown of every language,
# where the texts say [ADRESSE / ADDRESS] or
# [GERICHTSSTAND / PLACE OF JURISDICTION]. Fill them in here once; do not edit
# the placeholders in legal/*/*.md.
#
# address: street and number, then postcode and town. Use "|" between the
#          lines. Without the name and the country; the pages add those.
#          Example format: Musterstrasse 1 | 8000 Zürich
# jurisdiction: the town for the place of jurisdiction in the terms, without
#          "Switzerland". Example format: Zürich
#
# While a value still shows the placeholder, the pages print it highlighted
# and the build prints a warning.

address: Wiedingstrasse 87a | 8045 Zürich
jurisdiction: Zürich
